Question: My tracking says delivered, but I have not received my package. What do I do?
Answer: We apologize for the scare! Sometimes carriers mark a package as delivered 24 hours before it actually arrives. Please check with neighbors or your local post office. If it doesn't arrive by tomorrow, let us know and we will send a replacement immediately.

Question: Can I change my shipping address after placing an order?
Answer: If your order has not shipped yet, we can update your address! Please provide your order number and the new address right away. Once it has shipped, we cannot reroute it.

Question: Do you ship internationally?
Answer: Yes, we offer worldwide shipping! Standard international shipping takes 10-15 business days, while express international takes 3-5 business days. Customs duties may apply depending on your region.

Question: Why is my order delayed?
Answer: We sincerely apologize for the delay. Weather conditions, carrier backlogs, or high order volumes can sometimes slow things down. Please provide your order number so we can check the exact status for you.

Question: I missed the 30-day return window. Can I still return my item?
Answer: We generally stick to our 30-day policy, but we want you to be happy! For items slightly past the window, we can offer store credit instead of a refund. The item must still be unused and in original packaging.

Question: My item arrived damaged or defective. What do I do?
Answer: We are so sorry about that! Please reply with a photo of the damaged item and your order number. We will ship a free replacement to you immediately or issue a full refund, whichever you prefer.

Question: How do I print a return shipping label?
Answer: You can generate a prepaid return label directly from our returns portal. Just enter your order number and email address, select the item, and the label will be emailed to you instantly.

Question: When will I get my refund?
Answer: Once we receive your return at our warehouse, it takes 2-3 business days to process. After processing, the refund will reflect on your original payment method within 5-7 business days depending on your bank.

Question: How do I wash and care for your products?
Answer: To ensure longevity, we recommend machine washing on a cold, gentle cycle and hanging them to dry. Avoid using bleach or harsh chemicals to protect the eco-friendly dyes.

Question: What if the item I want is out of stock?
Answer: If an item is out of stock, you can sign up for restock notifications on the product page. You will receive an email the moment it becomes available again!

Question: Are the materials you use safe and hypoallergenic?
Answer: Yes! We only use 100% natural, non-toxic, and hypoallergenic materials. Our products are free from harsh chemicals and safe for sensitive skin.

Question: Are your sizing charts accurate?
Answer: Our items generally run true to size. We highly recommend checking the specific sizing chart linked on each product page, as exact measurements are provided there to help you find the perfect fit.

Question: I am extremely frustrated with your service and want to speak to a manager!
Answer: I deeply apologize for the frustration you've experienced, and I completely understand why you are upset. I am escalating this chat to our senior management team right now. They will review this and reach out to you within the hour to resolve this.

Question: This is the worst experience ever, give me my money back immediately!
Answer: I am so sorry that we let you down. This is not the standard we strive for. I will process a full refund for your order right away—no need to return the item. Please allow 3-5 days for the funds to appear in your account.

Question: You sent me the wrong item again! I am furious!
Answer: I am incredibly sorry for this repeated mistake. We completely dropped the ball. I am personally overnighting the correct item to you right now at no charge, and you can keep the wrong item. I will also flag this to our warehouse manager.

Question: Nobody is answering my emails! Is this a scam?
Answer: We are absolutely a legitimate business, and I am so sorry for the delay in email responses! We are currently experiencing an unusually high volume of inquiries. I am here now to help you immediately—what can I assist you with today?

Question: Where are you located and what are your business hours?
Answer: Our online store is open 24/7! Our customer support team is available to assist you Monday through Friday, from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Question: Are your manufacturing processes ethical and sustainable?
Answer: Absolutely. We pride ourselves on ethical manufacturing. All our workers receive fair wages in safe environments, and we use biodegradable, eco-friendly materials to minimize our carbon footprint.

Question: How can I contact corporate or wholesale support?
Answer: For B2B inquiries, wholesale orders, or corporate support, please email our dedicated corporate team or call our direct B2B line.
